acts.name: What they were waiting for
acts.desc: Jewish writings from before Jesus, describing the Messiah they expected

acts.name: An argument among Jews
acts.desc: The first followers were Jewish, and the debate stayed inside the family

acts.name: What Christians did next
acts.desc: Centuries of violence, the readings that hardened, and the repair that has started

turningPoints.AD 30: The Talmud records that from this year the Day of Atonement signs stopped working
turningPoints.AD 70: The Temple fell and sacrifice ended, closing the window Daniel 9 gave the anointed one
turningPoints.1096: Crusaders massacred Jewish communities, and Christian became a word Jewish families had reason to fear
turningPoints.c. 1100: Rashi read Isaiah 53 as Israel, and that reading became standard where it had not been
turningPoints.1941–45: Six million murdered in Christian Europe; no conversation about Jesus starts anywhere else now
turningPoints.1947: Isaiah 53 and Psalm 22 were proved pre-Christian, ending the claim that Christians edited them
